summary: The project Git settings token guide now shows instructions only for the Git provider in use instead of listing every provider.
userImpact: When only GitHub is enabled, the token setup guide and placeholder no longer mention GitLab, Bitbucket or Azure DevOps.
documentation: No technical documentation change; the guidance text is in the product UI.
rollback: Roll back to the previous host release to restore the combined token guide.
validation: The project Git settings component tests cover the provider-specific guide and the neutral token placeholder.

customerDocumentation.reason: The change narrows in-product guidance to the enabled provider; customer pages already describe GitHub tokens.
